metadata.novelty_explanation:
NOVEL

The proposed code replaces greedy target movement and random walking with risk-weighted Dijkstra search, staged key/door/exit objectives, and frontier exploration. It adds terrain memory, visit counts, dynamic-wall detection, diagonal movement constraints, and probabilistic enemy-danger estimates. Enemy sightings become current-observation-only, and interaction is enabled on every returned action. These substantially change navigation, exploration, and safety behavior.
